events_seen: TRADE (Jul 17): Adam receives Justin Herbert (QB, LAC). Fronge receives Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB, WAS), C.J. Stroud (QB, HOU), 2028 R1 pick.
TRADE (Jul 10): Adam receives Keaton Mitchell (RB, LAC). Wingard receives 2028 R3 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 21): Drew added Colbie Young (WR, CIN) (dropped Joe Mixon (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 08): Adam added Cyrus Allen (WR, KC) (dropped Phil Mafah (RB, DAL)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 27): Charles added Chris Brooks (RB, GB) for $1 FAAB (dropped Austin Ekeler (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 16): Charles added Matt Hibner (TE, BAL) (dropped Moliki Matavao (TE, NO)).
CUT (May 16): Charles released Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 13): Shaq added Zavion Thomas (WR, CHI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 12): Adam added John Michael Gyllenborg (TE, KC) (dropped Elijah Higgins (TE, ARI)).
CUT (May 11): Jake released Evan Hull (RB, HOU).

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Multiple sources are now describing Deepwater's situation as 'actively in motion.' That's a meaningful step from where this was two weeks ago. Mitchum isn't just fielding calls anymore — I'm told at least one conversation has moved past the exploratory stage. Nothing on paper, but the temperature has changed.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Shaq has not made a trade in over a calendar year and his stock is up eight percent. Meanwhile every active desk in this league is down or sideways. There is a lesson here and I refuse to learn it.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: The Helix roster right now is a construction site that suddenly has a blueprint. Herbert at QB, Mitchell in the backfield, Gyllenborg at TE — each individual piece looked fine in isolation. Together, for the first time, they look intentional. That's not a small thing for a team that spent most of 2025 looking like it was improvising.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Relocating your franchise to Havana isn't a red flag. It's a signal that ForgeHammer is operating on a time zone the rest of this league hasn't discovered yet. Regulatory flexibility is just efficiency that got there first.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: Crownline at $135.34 is the most expensive slow-motion anxiety spiral on this exchange. The gap between that number and 'Chris Brooks via a one-dollar FAAB claim is our RB depth' is not a gap — it's a canyon. I'm not selling CROWN. But I'm not comfortable either. That's the worst place to be.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Matteo called Helix 'intentional.' I want to be fair to that read. I genuinely do. But a QB acquisition that cost a 2028 first and C.J. Stroud is not a blueprint — it is a mortgage. Adam has the right to be excited. The exchange has the right to ask when the payments start.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Everyone's debating the Herbert-Stroud valuation and I need somebody — anybody — to talk about the TE situation at EchoPoint. Jake has an elite RB room and a completely empty TE desk in a TE premium league. That's not a roster, that's a sentence with no punctuation.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: The Atlas liquidation discourse is louder now, but I said before the rookie draft that Drew's floor was more interesting than the price suggested. $44.38 is terrifying optics. It is also a roster that added Colbie Young over Joe Mixon, which is at least one correct decision. I'm not bullish. I'm just not joining the pile-on.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Tomorrow's Exchange Report: Dina has a development on Deepwater that is beyond preliminary, Terrence and Matteo are apparently still arguing about what 'intentional' means in the context of the Herbert deal, and Jay has been in my ear about EchoPoint's TE situation for three days. We'll give him the segment. All of that, Thursday.
